name: Sawamura Nano
source:
The protagonist’s junior. She fell for the protagonist and enrolled in the same academy. Despite her appearance, she’s a terrible cook. She’s a shy girl.

She usually gets along well with Yuri and looks up to her like an older sister, but whenever the protagonist is involved, her shy personality completely changes, and she shows a bold side.

She loves sweets and manga, and she can’t resist milk candy. For some reason, she also loves cows and loves wearing her moo-print pajamas. Of course, she’s a virgin.

[From [url=http://www.sp-janis.com/speed/tabegoro/]official site[/url]]
